recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist double portrait featuring two stylized male figures against a flat landscape. The faces are rendered with smooth airbrushed gradients, where one side of each face is 'cut away' to reveal a dark, starry cosmic interior. The style uses soft-edged shapes, vibrant primary and secondary colors, and fine stippled textures to create a dreamlike, psychedelic atmosphere characteristic of late 1960s graphic art.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between flat, bright exterior skin and dark, textured cosmic interior
Symmetry of two figures occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame
Interaction between smooth airbrushed gradients and sharp graphic outlines
Integration of text into the upper sky area as a primary focal point
coreInvariants: Starry night sky texture inside facial silhouettes
Soft, rounded hair shapes with airbrushed highlights
Flat, rolling green hills in the background
Bright blue sky with no clouds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large busts centered in the lower foreground, filling the width of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, starry facial cutouts which draw the eye through high contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-center title, moves down to the cosmic eyes of the figures, and follows the curve of the shoulders.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is open blue sky, providing space for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and grass green provide the environmental foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy/black with white stippling creates the cosmic interior contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellows, oranges, and reds in the hair and clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with soft value transitions via airbrushing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, upright script with thick strokes and rounded terminals.
letterConstructionRules: Thick yellow fill with a thin red inner stroke and a heavy red outer drop shadow
Bouncy baseline for the main script elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase letters have large, circular counters
Ascenders and descenders are short and rounded
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary sans-serif or slab-serif for metadata, kept small and utilitarian.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the round, heavy, interlocking nature of the main text.
Provides the necessary weight and 60s-era rounded aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1960s airbrushed illustration of two male busts. The faces are split: one side is normal skin with soft gradients, the other side is a silhouette revealing a dark night sky with white stars. Background is a simple green hill under a flat blue sky. Style is clean, pop-surrealism.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, stacked text in the upper sky area. Use a heavy, rounded script with a bright yellow fill, a red inline, and a thick red drop shadow. Ensure letters are tightly packed.

verificationChecks: Does the cosmic texture appear only inside the facial silhouettes?
Is the airbrushing smooth without digital noise?
Is the text color palette strictly yellow and red?
Are the hills in the background simplified into rounded shapes?

adjustableVariables: Density of stars in the cosmic face
Intensity of the airbrushed highlights on the hair
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Unique logo in the top right corner
postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth color blending in the faces.
Verify the text has a distinct red drop shadow.
Ensure the cosmic interior has a stippled, not pixelated, look.
Confirm the composition is centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surrealist Portraiture] + [1960s Airbrush Technique] + [Cosmic Silhouette Motif] + [Heavy Rounded Script Typography].
